notes: A refreshed, modern look throughout, plus a clearer and safer capture flow. Modern rounded buttons, toggle switches, and input fields; a tidier, scrollable Settings panel; crisp gear/collapse/close icons. New Region now guides first-time setup and Capture auto-starts region selection if none is set. Too-small or empty captures are caught before they can reach your report. Grouped study menus (LE Arterial, Abdominal US, OB) and expanded Cardiac MRI (valve flow, Qp/Qs, T2*), plus the Coronary Calcium CT study.
